messages:
sara_support: forwarding ACME oncall notes — p95 stable, p99 jumped from ~600ms to ~2.4s since ~09:10 UTC, customer sees intermittent 500s and slow tails. attaching sample logs.
acme_oncall: logs attached in ticket #ACME-1187 — heap shows fragmentation, per-gpu RSS oscillating, KV entries growing during steady traffic.
li_engineer: can you paste the heatmap and per-node mem stats? guessing KV growth + allocator fragmentation causing slow GC/evictions.
acme_oncall: heatmap: node-gpu-7 shows +1.2GiB RSS delta over 30m, slab_free drops, p99 CPU spikes on memcpy.
jon_oncall: starting surface triage: check node-level oom_kill, cgroup throttles, and allocator for slab compaction toggles.
mike_ops: I see repeated realloc failures in logs: "failed to allocate chunk: try_coalesce returned false" — sounds like slab fragmentation in our custom allocator.
li_engineer: fair. quick mitigations: 1) enable slab compaction (rollout small config) 2) reduce per-request batch_size to limit KV prefetch 3) force kv-eviction policy to LRU-penalty for these nodes.
sara_support: can we do a quick hotfix for ACME? they want minimal disruption.
jon_oncall: plan: i) cordon+drain node-gpu-7 from pool so we can restart runtime process ii) apply slab_compact=true flag to runtime config iii) lower default batch_size=4 for their tenant iv) monitor p99 and RSS.
li_engineer: command to flip config via ops API:

```
POST /api/v1/runtime/config
body: {"tenant":"acme","slab_compact":true,"batch_size_override":4}
```

will push only to their routing pool.
mike_ops: i can run that now and then restart runtime on node-gpu-7 with zero-downtime drain.
acme_oncall: prefer short maintenance window — ok to drain one node at a time.
alloc-bot: automated check: detected fragmentation score 0.78 on node-gpu-7 (threshold 0.6) — recommend compaction.
jon_oncall: mike, after applying config, drain node-gpu-7: `kubectl drain node-gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` then restart runtime pod: `kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-runtime -n inference`.
mike_ops: done. pushed config + restarted runtime on node-gpu-7, draining started. watching metrics.
li_engineer: initial telemetry: p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 750ms within 2 minutes, RSS decreased ~900MiB on node-gpu-7, kv-entry-count growth slowed.
acme_oncall: customer reports significant improvement, 500 errors stopped, p99 stable around 700-800ms now. thanks.
sara_support: good. next steps: li to open follow-up to tune allocator (split large slabs, free list coalescing improvements) and add automated compaction when fragmentation>0.6. jon to add runbook steps. mike to schedule patch window for global rollout.
li_engineer: will file ENG-ALLOC-239 with repro and memory dumps, include suggested allocator changes and perf regression tests.
jon_oncall: adding runbook: short commands for toggling slab_compact and batch_size per-tenant + how to cordon/drain safely.
mike_ops: scheduling global staged rollout next week; will monitor per-tenant kv growth and fragmentation alarms.
sara_support: closing loop with ACME and documenting mitigation in ticket. :thumbsup:
